SeedLibrary.SeedLibraryPatch.jsonMergePa.description:
The API representation of a SeedLibrary entity, separate from the Doctrine model.

- Reads (Get, GetCollection): the Doctrine provider loads the entity (stateOptions),
  then the object mapper maps it onto this class (#[Map(source: ...)]).
- Writes (Post, Patch): the body is deserialized into the operation's input DTO,
  validated, mapped onto the entity (the DTO's #[Map(target: ...)]), validated again,
  persisted, and mapped back onto this class for the response.

The resource is identified by its uuid (/api/seed_libraries/{uuid}); the entity's
int id never leaves the database. Keep this the only class mapped from the entity:
Symfony registers a single reverse mapping per source class.

moves to another library through PATCH /api/seed_lots/{uuid} {"seedLibrary": uuid}.

SeedLot.SeedLotPatch.jsonMergePatch.description:
The API representation of a SeedLot entity (see SeedLibrary for the read/write flow).

Its relations are exposed by uuid, not by IRI nor as nested resources:

    {
      "@id": "/api/seed_lots/0199...",
      "uuid": "0199...",
      "seedLibrary": "0199...",
      "characteristics": ["0199...", "0199..."]
    }

and written the same way, through SeedLotPost and SeedLotPatch.

Its state follows SeedLotWorkflow, changed through one PATCH per transition
(/api/seed_lots/{uuid}/reserve, /release, /give) handled by lychen/api's
WorkflowTransitionProcessor: 200 with the lot, or 409 when its state does not allow it.

characteristics.description:
Nullable so that an explicit null is accepted, and IsNotNull maps it like an absent
property: the characteristics are left as they are. [] is mapped, and unlinks them
all. #[UuidExists] skips null too.
